subject: Helix AI renewal: usage delta, ROI recap & term scenarios
messages:
From: Marco Diaz <marco@helix.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Usage health & upcoming renewal (Q3)

Hi Naomi,

Quick note as we head into our July planning: our inference token consumption spiked in June after a feature rollout and we’re approaching the renewal window for our hosted plan (current term ends 2027-09-30). Can you help us understand:

- What caused the June delta (we've attached June usage CSV).
- If our current commit tiers still make sense for a 12-month renewal.
- Rough ROI for switching some latency-critical endpoints to Dedicated capacity (we're sensitive to 95th pct latency).

We’re gathering materials for procurement and would like a short written health recap + 1-2 recommended term scenarios we can share internally.

Thanks — Marco
Marco Diaz
VP of Engineering, Helix AI
Marco mobile: +1 415-555-0142
attachments: monthly_usage.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Diaz <marco@helix.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Usage health & upcoming renewal (Q3)

Thanks Marco — I pulled together a short analysis and two pragmatic renewal options. See key findings below; attached fuller report and cost model.

On Sun, Jul 18, 2027 at 9:12 AM Marco Diaz <marco@helix.ai> wrote:
> Quick note as we head into our July planning: our inference token consumption spiked in June after a feature rollout...

Summary (quick):
- June spike: +62% month-over-month total tokens; primary driver = increased calls to the summarization endpoint (prod) after model bump to redwood-3o. Endpoint accounted for ~48% of added tokens.
- Token mix: 78% generation tokens, 22% embeddings/reranking. Average prompt length increased by ~40 tokens.
- Unit cost impact: current hosted bill jumped ~31% vs May (after model spec change). With current throughput pattern, projected 12-mo spend grows ~22% YoY.

Recommendation (two scenarios):
1) Term scenario A — 12mo renewal, +25% commit (price locked), $120k in burst credits for Q3 ramp. Pros: predictable unit economics, low friction. Cons: still higher per-token cost on latency-critical endpoints.

2) Term scenario B — Hybrid: 12mo renewal for baseline usage + migrate 2 latency-critical endpoints to Dedicated (reserved GPUs) with a 6mo test pilot. Estimated delta: +$85k/month for Dedicated nodes initially, but median 95th-pct tail latency improves 40–60% and unit cost on those endpoints drops ~35% after batching/kv cache tuning. Pros: cost per critical request improves and latency SLAs achievable. Cons: onboarding and infra commit.

Attachments: helix_q2_usage_report.pdf (detailed charts), cost_model_v2.xlsx (sensitivity model).

Next steps I recommend:
- Ben to provide pricing addendum and draft amendment for procurement.
- Grace to scope Dedicated onboarding timeline (2–4 weeks pilot).

Happy to jump on a 30-min review with your procurement and eng leads — what slots work this week?

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior CSM, Redwood Inference
attachments: helix_q2_usage_report.pdf (PDF, 1.6MB); cost_model_v2.xlsx (Excel, 230KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Diaz <marco@helix.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-21T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Usage health & upcoming renewal (Q3) — proposal and draft amendment

Hi Marco — looping in pricing details and draft amendment. Thanks Naomi for the analysis — very helpful.

Pricing at a glance (estimates):
- Scenario A (12mo, +25% commit): effective blended unit rate down ~12% vs current list. We can offer an onboarding credit of 10% of next quarter spend to offset ramp.
- Scenario B (Hybrid + Dedicated pilot): one-time setup fee for Dedicated onboarding: $12,500. Reserved capacity estimate: ~$85k/month (as Naomi notes) for the initial pool to meet current latency targets; committed discount applied after pilot conversion.

I've uploaded a redline for the term amendment (term_amendment_draft.docx) and opened a DocuSign envelope for approval if you want to accept Scenario A quickly: https://docusign.com/abcdef1234567890

If you prefer the Hybrid path, Grace can run a 2-week pilot plan that includes a traffic split experiment (5–15% to Dedicated) and a clear abort/convert decision gate.

Logistics:
- Procurement items: SOW for Dedicated onboarding, PO cadence, and an SLA addendum for latency.*
- For legal — if you want a 60-day term to evaluate Dedicated before committing to a 12-mo bucket, we can draft a staged-commit amendment.

Availability: I can join a call Tue/Wed morning PST. Naomi — please flag any constraints for Grace's pilot scheduling.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: term_amendment_draft.docx (Word, 48KB)
